questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'Neither of the students _____ finished the exam.'
questions.hint: Neither is singular.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'Either the teacher or the students _____ writing on the board.'
questions.hint: Verb agrees with the closer subject.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'The team _____ practicing hard for the tournament.'
questions.hint: Collective noun treated as singular.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'Each of the candidates _____ interviewed separately.'
questions.hint: Each is singular.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'Bread and butter _____ our daily breakfast.'
questions.hint: Bread and butter is treated as a single compound subject.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'Ten thousand dollars _____ a lot of money.'
questions.hint: Sum of money is treated as singular.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'The jury _____ divided in their opinions.'
questions.hint: Jury members acting individually take plural verb.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'Physics _____ my favorite subject in high school.'
questions.hint: Subject names ending in -s are singular.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'A number of students _____ absent today.'
questions.hint: 'A number of' is plural, 'The number of' is singular.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'The number of active volunteers _____ increasing daily.'
questions.hint: 'The number of' takes a singular verb.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'Many a student _____ made the same mistake.'
questions.hint: 'Many a' is singular.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'He, along with his friends, _____ going to the party.'
questions.hint: Parenthetical expressions don't change subject number.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'There _____ many reasons to support the project.'
questions.hint: Verb agrees with the real subject 'reasons'.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'Politics _____ a dirty game, some say.'
questions.hint: Politics is singular.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'The scissors _____ on the table.'
questions.hint: Scissors is always plural.

questions.question: Change the sentence to passive voice: 'The dog bit the man.'
options: The man was bitten by the dog.
The man is bitten by the dog.
The man had been bitten by the dog.
The dog was bitten by the man.
questions.hint: Past simple passive is was/were + past participle.

questions.question: Change the sentence to passive voice: 'She is writing a letter.'
options: A letter is being written by her.
A letter was written by her.
A letter is written by her.
A letter was being written by her.
questions.hint: Present continuous passive uses is/are + being + past participle.

questions.question: Change the sentence to active voice: 'The cake was eaten by John.'
questions.hint: Past simple active.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: 'He is proficient _____ English and Mathematics.'
questions.hint: Proficient in something.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: 'She is angry _____ her brother's behavior.'
questions.hint: Angry at behavior, angry with a person.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: 'We arrived _____ the airport just in time.'

questions.question: Complete the sentence: 'He has been suffering _____ fever since yesterday.'
questions.hint: Suffering from a disease/condition.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: 'She is fond _____ classical music.'
questions.hint: Fond of.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: 'He was accused _____ theft.'

questions.question: Complete the sentence: 'You must abide _____ the rules of the foundation.'
questions.hint: Abide by.
